subject: Math
prompt: A plant nursery has three greenhouses for growing saplings before they are transplanted. Nine saplings with heights less than $20$ centimeters are placed in greenhouse A. Thirteen saplings with heights of at least $20$ centimeters but no more than $35$ centimeters are placed in greenhouse B. Eleven saplings with heights greater than $35$ centimeters are placed in greenhouse C. Which of the following could be the median of the heights, in centimeters, of these $33$ saplings?
explanation: Choice B is correct. The median of a set of numbers is the middle value when the values are ordered from least to greatest. There are $33$ saplings, so in an ordered list of the heights, the $17$th value would be the median height. The $9$ saplings in greenhouse A have the smallest heights, so these would be the $1$st through $9$th values in the ordered list. The $13$ saplings in greenhouse B have the next set of higher heights, so they would be the $10$th through $22$nd values in the ordered list, which includes the $17$th value. The saplings in greenhouse B have heights of at least $20$ centimeters but no more than $35$ centimeters; of the given choices, only $28$ centimeters falls within this range.
